description: This PHP script is part of the Revive Adserver project, providing an admin interface for checking and managing user passwords, including resetting passwords and sending related emails.

classes.name: class
classes.description: Anonymous class handling user password checks and email notifications within the admin interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, fetching users with empty or 32-character passwords from the database.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main execution method that displays the form, handles form submission, and sends emails.

methods.name: hasUsersNeedingUpdate
methods.description: Checks if there are users requiring password updates.

methods.name: sendEmails
methods.description: Sends password update or welcome emails based on selected users.

methods.name: generateForm
methods.description: Creates and returns the form for selecting users needing password resets.
